title: Actual retained occurrences through scoped relationships and applicability consumers
question: Do actual authenticated source occurrences and component targets produce replayable constraint-governed relationships without question-centric claim identity or arbitrary role carriers?
method: Actual registered source-role projection, E5 encoding and native linking/applicability followed by ordinary read/export; fresh CLI and stdio MCP parity; scoped native/common-publication forgery controls and exact same-span role-carrier regression.
conclusion: Actual run127 retains two384D vectors, one source occurrence and canonical defined-by edge from an authenticated component; run130 retains private exact defining-occurrence applicability, with unknown transfer premises withheld. Reader/export and fresh CLI/MCP pass, comparing all stable binding/content and retaining separate capture IDs. Each edge uses its own qualified occurrence carrier, order-independent; native forward/reverse controls pass. Independent corpus relationship/applicability support, public corpus applicability, held-out efficacy, calibration and full WCE qualification are not established.
